Four were real gaps and are now tested: the lexical half of the container path confinement (every case in the confinement test resolved to a real path, so rejectLinkEscape answered them all and inverting the string check left the test green - a path that escapes lexically with a nonexistent target was the missing case, and it is the security-relevant one); caseFolds indexing out[1] on a one-rune fold set, which only happens for a case-insensitive pattern holding a caseless character like (?i)v2; a NUL at position 0 slipping the container write guard; and a blind spot in the Go-based differential itself, which claimed ERE was a subset of RE2 - it is not, because RE2 reads a backslash inside a bracket as an escape where POSIX reads it as a literal, so the correct rendering of [a\\b] is [a-b\] which both real greps accept and Go rejects. That case moved to the docker parity test. WORKERS=1 throughout: this package now spawns containers in its own tests.
